name: homeroom-brand
description: Homeroom's brand. Use when making anything for Homeroom (post, ad, slide, email, page, screen or copy) so it matches its colours, type, logo and voice, and when changing the default look, app icon style or featured illustration guidance that new Homeroom apps start from.

# Homeroom brand

Everything you need is in this file. DESIGN.md, BRAND.md and an assets folder may sit next to it with the same rules plus pictures and fonts; use them when they're there.

## Where the brand lives in this repository

- **This folder** is the kit itself: the rules below, `BRAND.md` (voice),
  `DESIGN.md` (tokens) and `assets/` (logos, fonts, pictures). Edit the kit
  here, never a copy of it.
- **Hosted for apps** at `/usernode-native/v1/brand/`
  (`public/usernode-native/v1/brand/`): `brand.css` (the two typefaces and
  the palette as `--hr-*` variables), the fonts and the logo files. Every
  app reaches that path on its own origin, the same way it reaches the
  native UI kit. The fonts and logos there are copies of `assets/`;
  `tests/homeroom-brand-kit.test.js` keeps them identical.
- **The default look of a new app.** The starter's design kit
  (`DESIGN_KIT_CSS` and the scaffold's `tailwind.config.js` in
  `src/services/template.js`) starts on this palette and type, and its
  `CLAUDE.md` "## Design" names it. An app keeps it unless its request or
  its builders choose another look.
- **App icons and featured illustrations.** The platform conventions'
  "Icon style" and "Featured illustration" sections
  (`src/prompts/app-conventions.md`) draw both from this palette.
- **Not yet the Homeroom shell.** The platform's own screens keep the
  `zinc`/`violet` vocabulary that AGENTS.md describes. Moving the shell onto
  this brand is a separate, deliberate change.

## Every time
1. Background `#FFFEEA`, text `#000000`, colours only from the palette below.
2. Headlines in Source Serif 4 (weight 460), body in Geist. Load them from `assets/fonts/` if they're there; both are open-licence fonts.
3. Use the real logo: copy the SVG from "Logo files" at the end of this file. Never draw or retype it.
4. Pictures: use the brand's own from `assets/pictures/` if they're there, or ask the person to attach one from Homeroom's brand page. Never invent people or products.
5. Write in Homeroom's voice. No hype words, no invented numbers, customers or features. If you don't know what something does, ask.

## Sizes
X post 1200 x 675, square 1080 x 1080, LinkedIn banner 1584 x 396, X header 1500 x 500.


## Overview

Homeroom: AI made everyone a builder. Homeroom makes building multiplayer. Homeroom lets communities build apps together with AI. Anyone can describe a change, preview it with others, vote on what ships and get credit for helping build it.

AI made everyone a builder. Homeroom makes building multiplayer.

Homeroom lets communities build apps together with AI. Anyone can describe a change, preview it with others, vote on what ships and get credit for helping build it.

## Colors



- **Cream** `#FFFEEA` (core)
- **Yellow** `#FFEE6F` (core)
- **Blue** `#3090E1` (core)
- **Green** `#A9CF97` (core)
- **White** `#FFFFFF` (secondary)
- **Pale yellow** `#FCFAB3` (secondary)
- **Black** `#000000` (secondary)
- **Grey** `#B9B9B9` (secondary)

Pairs that work (background, then text on it):

- Cream: `#FFFEEA` with `#000000` text
- Yellow: `#FFEE6F` with `#000000` text
- Blue: `#2F8FE3` with `#000000` text
- Green: `#9DC48C` with `#000000` text
- Black: `#000000` with `#FFFEEA` text

## Typography

As our primary typeface, STK Bureau Serif introduces precision, scientific clarity, and computational restraint into Homeroom’s identity. Its engineered serif structure bridges research credibility with modern systems thinking, moving away from the conventional biotech aesthetic of overly clinical sans serifs or speculative futurism.

As our supporting typeface, Geist brings clarity, neutrality, and systems level readability to Homeroom’s communication layer. Its structured geometry and technical precision complement the sophistication of STK Bureau Serif, creating a balanced typographic system that feels both scientific and operational.

STK Bureau is a licensed font, so the samples on this page are set in Source Serif 4 until the licensed file is added.

- Headlines: **Source Serif 4**, weight 460, tight tracking (-3.5%), short lines.
- Body, labels and UI: **Geist**, weight 400.
- Primary: STK Bureau Serif, Headlines and big statements.
- Secondary: Geist Regular, Body copy, descriptions and interface text.
- Secondary: Geist Medium, Labels, buttons and small headings.

Fonts are in `assets/fonts/`.

## Layout

- Generous margins and lots of empty space.
- Posts: a big headline in Source Serif 4, a picture or the brand's shape, the logo small in a corner, and `www.homeroom.app`.

## Logo



- **Backgrounds:** Black on yellow, cream on black, or in chrome.
- **App icon:** The H mark on a rounded square: cream on black, or black on cream.
- **Sizes:** The wordmark at 196, 144, 96, 60 and 32 pt.
- Use the real logo files. Don't redraw, recolour outside the palette, stretch, outline or add effects.

## Voice

- Smart without sounding smart
- We are: Conversational, Confident, Playful, Simple, Inviting.
- We aren't: Corporate, Hype-y, Silly, Technical, Instructional.
- Say "Come build with us". Don't say "Leverage our collaborative infrastructure".

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do: the palette above, Source Serif 4 headlines, the real logo and pictures.
- Don't: other fonts, colours outside the palette, stock "AI" looks, invented numbers, customers or features.

# Voice (BRAND.md)

## In one line
AI made everyone a builder. Homeroom makes building multiplayer.

## Voice
Smart without sounding smart

We are: Conversational, Confident, Playful, Simple, Inviting.
We aren't: Corporate, Hype-y, Silly, Technical, Instructional.

| We say | We never say |
| --- | --- |
| Come build with us | Leverage our collaborative infrastructure |

## How to write
- Short sentences, in the brand's voice above.
- Specific beats grand. No hype words.
- Never invent stats, customer names, prices or features. If a fact isn't given, leave it out or ask.

## Lines from the brand's own work
- Stop building for people. Build with them.
- Introducing Community Voting
- The room is open for everyone
- Help build it. Get credit for it.

## Facts you can use
- Website: www.homeroom.app
